name: alakazam_goal_v1
rule_changes: Enumerate every deterministic same-turn KO route for each visible target.
Choose outcomes lexicographically so a non-winning two-prize KO dominates a non-winning one-prize KO regardless of role-score magnitude.
Lock the concrete target through the turn, allowing replans for wins, larger prize KOs, or major same-prize role upgrades.
Boost only one canonical next route action and keep Boss's Orders last.
Match evolution steps to the exact intended Abra or Kadabra.
Keep two-hit pressure on an Active Grimmsnarl ex instead of immediately gusting a lower-prize Munkidori.
Allow Active Dudunsparce to cycle at one or two deck cards only when the promoted benched Alakazam takes a same-turn KO.
Allow Dudunsparce attach-retreat only when its full retreat cost is paid and the benched Alakazam takes a same-turn KO.
Use non-Mist Enhanced Hammer only for concrete immediate attack denial or an HP-removal KO exception.
Replace the old model's useful development override with explicit constructive-evolution-before-Fezandipiti ordering.
known_limitations: A new live ladder rating has not been measured; stable rating 900 or 1000 remains a target, not a validated result.
Teacher-forced comparison does not simulate the counterfactual board trajectory after a changed action.
Expert-action agreement is a safety and direction check, not a win-rate estimator.
The official cg package is not installed locally, so the delivered artifact is a source ZIP rather than a final Kaggle tar.gz.
